## Notebooks v1.1.0

### What's new

* **Works on newer Kindles:** tested on the Kindle 11th gen (2022), firmware 5.18.1.
* **Right size on sharper screens:** on screens with more pixels than the Paperwhite 2 (e.g. the 300 ppi Kindle 11th gen), the whole app scales up so text and buttons are the same physical size. The writing toolbar still sits just above the keyboard.
* **No doubled title:** on firmware 5.16 and later the Kindle always shows its own title bar with the app's name, so the home screen drops its own "Notebooks" heading.
* **Reading now:** when the book's title runs onto two lines, the note and highlight counts move onto the author line instead of being hidden behind the Open notebook button.
* **Launcher fix:** clearing out a leftover Notebooks window now also works on newer firmware.

### Install / upgrade

Download `notebooks-1.1.0.zip` below, unzip it and copy `documents` and `extensions` into the root of the Kindle, replacing the old files. Your notes in `/notebooks/` are kept.

One ZIP works on both older soft-float firmware (e.g. Paperwhite 2 on 5.12) and newer hard-float firmware (5.16.3 and later).
